locator: CCC 199, « Credo in Deum »: haec prima Professionis fidei affirmatio est etiam omnium maxime fundamentalis
interpretation: CCC 199: '« Credo in Deum »: haec prima Professionis fidei affirmatio est etiam omnium maxime fundamentalis.' CCC 200: 'Confessio unicitatis Dei ... ab illa exsistentiae Dei est inseparabilis atque etiam prorsus fundamentalis.' The text calls the profession an affirmation and a confession of God's existence; it does not report how ordinary believers understand their recitation.
attribution: The passage states that 'I believe in God' is the first and most fundamental affirmation of the profession of faith and that the confession of God's oneness is inseparable from the confession of his existence, which is the premise.
